items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: It’s like the old story about the mountain coming to Muhammad.

ctx.x: Right. That’s right. We don’t them all coming down here, right?

But you see, speaking of that, I had a choice between going — I could have gone anywhere. I could have gone to L.A. to try to do the studios thing, I could have gone to New York or gone anywhere. But I chose to come to a little place like St. Petersburg. And it has blossomed into a big thing. It’s like the old story about the mountain coming to Muhammad. That’s what happened. All you need is the concept, and work long and hard enough. Persistence. You don’t necessarily need a great deal of talent but you need the…
Well said. Well thanks for your time today.
